proposals.evidence: Turner explicitly lists Bengali āila came, Old Maithili ayalahũ I came and Marathi ālā in the lla expansion of āgata. The eastern yel-/yāl-type come preterites and Vasavi ālo match that regional expanded past family. Danuwar yelo is explicitly tagged third-person singular preterite; the eastern onset/vowel reduction is a comparative qualification, not a general sound law. v-bearing forms with a potentially different present-stem origin are excluded.
